findings.documented: Documentation specifies user authentication at POST /v1/auth/login.
findings.actual: POST /v1/auth/login returns HTTP 404 Not Found. Real authentication endpoint is at POST /auth/login.
findings.how_found: Tested both path variations with X-API-Key and JSON body; POST /v1/auth/login returned 404, whereas POST /auth/login succeeded returning access_token and refresh_token.
findings.impact: API clients authenticating via documented path will fail with 404.

findings.documented: Documentation describes GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} for managing saved properties.
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites routes return HTTP 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Issued GET, POST, and DELETE requests to /v1/favourites with valid Bearer token; server returned 404 for all methods.
findings.impact: Favourites feature cannot be built using the documented path.

findings.documented: Endpoint /v1/saved is not mentioned in API_REFERENCE.md.
findings.actual: GET /v1/saved returns user saved listings (200 OK), POST /v1/saved saves a listing by listing_id (201 Created), DELETE /v1/saved/{id} removes it (200 OK).
findings.how_found: Automated candidate-path discovery scan; /v1/saved responded with full CRUD for saved listings.
findings.impact: Applications must use /v1/saved instead of /v1/favourites to persist saved listings.

findings.actual: Returns HTTP 404 Not Found for all listing IDs.
findings.how_found: Queried GET /v1/listings/MAG-1002627/similar with valid token; received 404.
findings.impact: Similar listings feature cannot be populated via the backend.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics returns a market analytics summary.
findings.impact: Analytics must be computed client-side from raw dataset.

findings.documented: carpet_area is reported in square feet (sq.ft) across all listing records.
findings.actual: Listings from website == 'magichomes' report carpet_area in square meters (sq.m), e.g. 75 sq.m for a 2BHK flat. Other websites report in sq.ft.
findings.how_found: Compared carpet_area distributions by website: magichomes values ranged 45-180 (sq.m scale), while other portals ranged 400-2500 (sq.ft scale).
findings.impact: Price per sq.ft calculations for magichomes listings are distorted 10.76x unless converted using the 10.7639 factor.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max in /v1/projects are in raw INR.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are expressed in Lakhs INR (e.g. 99.8 = 99.8 Lakhs = Rs 9,980,000).
findings.how_found: Compared P10068 price_max=99.8 against its linked listing prices (Rs 4,080,000 to Rs 14,750,000), confirming Lakhs unit.
findings.impact: UI displaying project prices without Lakhs adjustment shows Rs 99.8 instead of Rs 99.8 Lakhs.

findings.documented: Pagination uses page and limit parameters, with default 20 and max 100.
findings.actual: API uses offset and limit (not page). Server caps limit at 50 regardless of requested value. Reported total metadata (4535) differs from total retrievable records (4700).
findings.how_found: Tested limit=100 (server returned limit: 50); iterated with offset increments until has_more: false at offset 4650.
findings.impact: Page-based navigation fails; limit capped at 50 means more API calls required to retrieve full dataset.

findings.documented: All listing records contain valid property dimensions, floor numbers, and coordinates.
findings.actual: 214 listing records contain physically impossible data: floor > total_floors, total_floors <= 0, carpet_area > super_built_up_area, bedroom <= 0, bathroom <= 0, or coordinates outside Bangalore bounds.
findings.how_found: Applied physical constraint validation across all 4700 listing records programmatically.
findings.impact: Including these records in calculations produces distorted metrics (e.g. avg price per sq.ft).

findings.documented: All listings represent genuine property sale offerings.
findings.actual: 16 listings contain fake or clickbait pricing (negative prices or monthly rental values listed as sale price) to generate lead enquiries.
findings.how_found: Filtered complete dataset for price < 100000 INR; inspected each record to confirm anomaly pattern.
findings.impact: Users see absurd or negative prices unless these listings are excluded.

findings.documented: Each project's total_listings field reflects the count of listings linked to that project in /v1/listings.
findings.actual: 392 out of 520 projects report a total_listings count that does not match the actual number of listings with that project_id in the complete /v1/listings dataset.
findings.how_found: Fetched all listings, grouped by project_id, compared actual counts against total_listings in each project record.
findings.impact: Project listing counters in UI are unreliable; 75% of projects show inaccurate availability.
